title: Training Camps
subtitle: The different and unique training camp, for one or for two
intro: We design your training camp to measure: we analyse your previous training and create the perfect plan for your goals. Unforgettable weeks in Lanzarote, with pleasant temperatures all year round. Now also in a hybrid training version, with sessions at our box.
advantages: Single or double format: come on your own or with your training partner
Dates and length of your choice (subject to accommodation availability)
Sessions focused on your goals and weaknesses
No mixed-level groups: you're never held back or left behind
Personal training: all the focus is on you
A whole apartment instead of a hotel room (your family can come too)
Island life away from mass tourism
Secret spots and the best of the island
included: Accommodation in a fully equipped apartment (up to 6 people)
Personal training sessions: running and running technique analysis — or hybrid training sessions at the box
pricesNote: Price per person with all services included. Other durations and companions on request.

extras.title: 4-week preparation plan
extras.text: A plan to arrive at the camp in shape, with an initial interview and analysis of your training.
